svg.title: The Knowledge Galaxy — the graph lens of Explore
svg.desc: Explore with the Graph lens: a starfield of notes grouped into coloured neighbourhoods, hub notes labelled and glowing, typed links coloured by relation, the selected notes lit and the rest dimmed, with search, fit, the options gear, a status line and legends.
svg.text: your selection, lit in the whole vault
